name: Security guard companies

problems.words: Posts are left empty at night and clients find out before we do
quick_ideas: Have supervisors call a few random posts at set times each night for a week, so you see how often posts are empty
Note which sites have gaps, so you know where to focus.

workzap_build.text: guard check-in on phone at the post with time and site location, and alerts to the supervisor when a post hasn't checked in.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many guards and sites are you running?
problems.free_stops: check-in frequency and alert rules are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Guards sign each other's attendance register
quick_ideas: Compare register signatures with a few surprise visits this week, so you see the size of the problem
Make clear to guards that attendance is being checked, so the habit stops.

workzap_build.text: phone check-in by each guard at the site, tied to time and location, replacing the paper register.

problems.free_stops: how check-ins are verified is kept for the solution document.

problems.words: Supervisors claim they did rounds but I can't verify
quick_ideas: Ask supervisors to send a photo from each site they visit tonight, so rounds leave a record
Compare that with their claimed rounds once, so you see the gap.

workzap_build.text: a supervisor visit log with site check-in and a short checklist per site, plus a nightly summary for the owner.

problems.free_stops: the checklist and summary format are worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: We don't have enough relievers, so guards do double duty
quick_ideas: Count double duties done this month, so you know the real reliever gap
List which sites need relievers most often, so cover is planned.

workzap_build.text: a digital roster by site and shift with a reliever pool and double-duty flags.

problems.free_stops: the roster rules are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Payroll is a fight every month over absences and fines
quick_ideas: Write down once how absences and deductions are worked out, so everyone knows the rule
Share each guard's attendance before payday this month, so disputes come up early.

workzap_build.text: salary worked out from check-in attendance with transparent deductions and an approval step.

problems.free_stops: how deductions are shown and approved is kept for the solution document.

problems.words: We bill clients for posts but sometimes the post wasn't covered
quick_ideas: Compare last month's billed posts against attendance once for a few sites, so mismatches show
Fix any wrong invoice now, so client trust is protected.

workzap_build.text: a post coverage report reconciling billed posts with actual covered hours every month.

problems.free_stops: how coverage and billing are reconciled is set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Clients pay after months but guards need salary on the 1st
quick_ideas: List every client invoice with its age, so you know who to chase first
Send invoices earlier in the month this time, so payment comes sooner.

workzap_build.text: receivables per client with ageing and scheduled reminders, alongside the coming salary run.

problems.free_stops: reminder timings and the cash view are kept for the solution document.

problems.words: Uniforms and equipment issued are never returned
quick_ideas: Count the kit in your store and at a few posts once, so you know what's out
Start signing kit out on issue, so returns can be checked.

workzap_build.text: a kit and equipment register by guard role and post, with issue and return recorded.

problems.free_stops: the issue and return routine is designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Incident reports come in as voice notes and get lost
quick_ideas: Pull this month's incident voice notes into one written list, so nothing is forgotten
Name one person who receives incident reports, so they have a home.

workzap_build.text: an incident form via WhatsApp or app with photo, time and post, routed to the supervisor and owner.

problems.free_stops: the form fields and routing are worked out in the solution document.

never_say: Any weapons, tactical, licensing, safety-engineering, legal or labour-law advice. Anything involving falsified attendance, fake training certificates, unlawful underpayment or covert surveillance. That posts will always be covered or incidents prevented. Requests for guard names, IDs, licence or weapon numbers, or client site layouts. Any live threat, robbery, violence or injury: point to police and emergency services first 15 / 1122 in Pakistan, 999 / 998 in UAE, 911 in Canada).

sample_reply.person: Raat ko posts khali hoti hain aur client ko hum se pehle pata chal jata hai. Is ka kya hal hai?
sample_reply.pi: Ji haan, is ka hal mumkin hai aur is hafte se shuruaat ki ja sakti hai. 1 Ek hafte tak supervisor raat ko kuch posts ko alag alag waqt pe call karein, taake pata chale khali post kitni baar hoti hai. 2 Jin sites pe gap mile unki ek list bana lein, taake tawajjoh sahi jagah ho. Workzap yeh aap ke liye automatically kar sakta hai: guard post se phone pe check-in kare aur check-in na ho to supervisor ko foran alert jaye. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
